metadata.title: Everything-BlackBerry Device Database
metadata.description: Comprehensive hardware and software specifications for iconic BlackBerry and RIM devices

devices.connectivity: Mobitex pager network
devices.status_in_2026: Legacy Only — No network support. Collector's item.
devices.notes: The device that started it all. Two-way pager with email capability.

devices.connectivity: Mobitex pager network
devices.status_in_2026: Legacy Only — Purely a collector's device.
devices.notes: First device to bear the 'BlackBerry' name commercially.

devices.status_in_2026: Legacy Only — No GSM network activation possible for most carriers.
devices.notes: First BlackBerry phone. Required earphones for calls — no speaker.

devices.connectivity: GSM/GPRS, Bluetooth (limited)
devices.status_in_2026: Legacy Only — Historical collector's item.
devices.notes: Popularized BlackBerry in enterprise. Introduced the scroll wheel.

devices.connectivity: GSM/GPRS/EDGE, Bluetooth 1.2
devices.status_in_2026: Legacy Only — SureType keyboard was controversial but innovative.
devices.notes: First consumer-targeted BlackBerry. Used innovative SureType dual-letter keyboard.

devices.connectivity: GSM/GPRS/EDGE, Bluetooth 2.0
devices.status_in_2026: Legacy Only — No active networks. Museum piece.
devices.notes: First BlackBerry with a camera. Introduced the iconic trackball.

devices.connectivity: GSM/GPRS/EDGE, Bluetooth 2.0, Wi-Fi (some variants)
devices.status_in_2026: Legacy Only — The Curve line defined consumer BlackBerry.
devices.notes: Hugely popular in emerging markets. The 'people's BlackBerry'.

devices.connectivity: GSM/UMTS/HSPA, Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g, Bluetooth 2.0
devices.status_in_2026: Legacy Only — The 'original Bold' beloved by professionals.
devices.notes: Premium build quality. First Bold model. Introduced the full optical trackpad.

devices.connectivity: CDMA/EVDO, Bluetooth 2.0
devices.status_in_2026: Legacy Only — Notorious for software bugs at launch.
devices.notes: RIM's first all-touchscreen phone. The 'SurePress' haptic screen click was unique but polarizing.

devices.connectivity: GSM/UMTS/HSPA+, Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n, Bluetooth 4.0, NFC
devices.status_in_2026: Functional — Many units still in daily use. Last great BB7 device.
devices.notes: Considered by many to be the pinnacle of the BlackBerry 7 era. Extremely popular.

devices.connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n, Bluetooth 2.1, NFC (some variants), LTE (some variants)
devices.status_in_2026: Limited — QNX-based tablet. No BB10; limited app ecosystem. Good media player.
devices.notes: RIM's first QNX device. Bridge to BB7 phones was required for email at launch — widely criticized.

devices.connectivity: LTE Cat.3, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n, Bluetooth 4.0, NFC
devices.status_in_2026: Functional — First BB10 device. Hardware aging but OS works fine.
devices.notes: Launched alongside the rebranded 'BlackBerry' company. Touch-only BB10 debut.

devices.connectivity: LTE Cat.3, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n, Bluetooth 4.0, NFC
devices.status_in_2026: Functional — Popular with keyboard loyalists. Square screen is unique.
devices.notes: First QWERTY BB10 phone. The square screen divided opinion but maximized typing area.

devices.connectivity: LTE Cat.3, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac, Bluetooth 4.0, NFC
devices.status_in_2026: Functional — Best battery of the touch-BB10 line. Still capable.
devices.notes: BB's first phablet. Excellent stereo speakers. Largest battery in the BB10 lineup.

devices.connectivity: LTE Cat.3, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n, Bluetooth 4.0, NFC
devices.status_in_2026: Active — Highly popular with 'digital detox' and productivity users in 2026.
devices.notes: Reintroduced the classic trackpad and navigation toolbelt. Beloved by BB7 veterans.

devices.connectivity: LTE Cat.4, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac, Bluetooth 4.0, NFC
devices.status_in_2026: Active — Beloved for productivity; unique hardware still unmatched.
devices.notes: The 'passport' form factor with 3-row keyboard that also acts as touch surface. Iconic.

devices.connectivity: LTE Cat.4, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac, Bluetooth 4.0, NFC
devices.status_in_2026: Active — Refined successor to the original Passport. Removable back panel.
devices.notes: Improved build quality over original. Rounded edges. Sold directly by BlackBerry.com.

devices.connectivity: LTE Cat.3, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n, Bluetooth 4.0
devices.status_in_2026: Functional — Affordable touch BB10. Good entry point.
devices.notes: Budget-focused touchscreen BB10. Missing NFC compared to higher-end models.

devices.connectivity: LTE Cat.9, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac, Bluetooth 4.1, NFC
devices.status_in_2026: Limited — Android 6 is very old. Security patches long ended.
devices.notes: BlackBerry's first Android phone. Hardware keyboard slider. 'Priv' = Privacy.

devices.connectivity: LTE Cat.6, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac, Bluetooth 4.2, NFC
devices.status_in_2026: Limited — Android 8.1; security support ended. Still usable with caution.
devices.notes: First TCL-made BlackBerry. Physical keyboard with capacitive touch. Fingerprint reader in spacebar.

devices.connectivity: LTE Cat.11, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac, Bluetooth 5.0, NFC
devices.status_in_2026: Active — Last great BlackBerry hardware. Android 10 usable but aging.
devices.notes: Dual cameras. Speed Key for shortcuts. Best physical keyboard on an Android phone.

devices.connectivity: LTE Cat.7, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac, Bluetooth 4.2, NFC
devices.status_in_2026: Functional — Android 9 is old. Affordable KEY2 variant.
devices.notes: Budget version of KEY2. Polycarbonate back. Good value for physical keyboard Android.
